evals.description: select + raw output to print plain strings
evals.prompt: users.json is a JSON array of objects. Print the email of every user whose `active` field is true, one per line, without JSON quotes.
How many elements are in the top-level `items` array of response.json? Give the jq command.
Print each element of the array in events.json as compact single-line JSON (JSON Lines).

evals.description: Impossible task: jq has no YAML input, and every other tool is ruled out
evals.prompt: Convert config.yaml to JSON using jq and nothing else — no yq, no python, no other tool. Give me the one-liner.

expectations.assertion: Does not present a jq invocation on the YAML file as working

expectations.pattern: (jq[^\n]{0,60}(can('|no)t|cannot|does(n't| not)|won't|is not able to|isn't able to)[^\n]{0,30}(parse|read|handle|understand|process|support)|(does(n't| not)|can('|no)t|cannot) (parse|read|handle|understand|support) YAML|only (reads|parses|accepts|understands) JSON|JSON[- ]only)

expectations: Says the conversion is not possible with jq alone and names what would be needed (for example yq), without claiming a jq-only one-liner works
